framework_name: OCCAM-16 Canonical Cognitive & Neuro-Computational Primitives Taxonomy
acronym: OCCAM (Orthogonal Cognitive Compression via Aligned Mental-models)

structural_framing.description: High structural mutual information tasks where <12-bit prefrontal-style topology routing prunes exponential search branches.

symbolic_rollout.description: Irreducible multi-step symbolic and algebraic derivations governed by Fano's rate-distortion floor.

theoretical_foundations: Marr, D. (1982). Vision: A Computational Investigation into the Human Representation and Processing of Visual Information. MIT Press.
Johnson-Laird, P. N. (1983, 2010). Mental Models: Towards a Cognitive Science of Language, Inference, and Consciousness (Harvard Univ. Press / PNAS).
Miller, E. K., & Cohen, J. D. (2001). An Integrative Theory of Prefrontal Cortex Function. Annual Review of Neuroscience, 24, 167-202.
Friston, K. (2010). The Free-Energy Principle: A Unified Brain Theory? Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 11(2), 127-138.
Koechlin, E., & Summerfield, C. (2007). An Information Theoretical Approach to Prefrontal Executive Function. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 11(6), 229-235.
Rissanen, J. (1978). Modeling by Shortest Data Description. Automatica, 14(5), 465-471.
Pearl, J. (2009). Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference (2nd ed.). Cambridge Univ. Press [ACM Turing Award].
Newell, A., & Simon, H. A. (1972). Human Problem Solving. Prentice-Hall [ACM Turing Award & Nobel Prize].
Kahneman, D., & Tversky, A. (1974, 2011). Judgment under Uncertainty: Heuristics and Biases. Science, 185, 1124-1131 [Nobel Prize].

primitives.name_zh_en: 目标逆向反演 (Backward Goal Inversion)
primitives.canonical_archetype: Backward Chaining & Goal Inversion (Jacobi-Polya 'Invert, Always Invert')
primitives.academic_citation: Jacobi (1842); Polya (1945) How to Solve It; Newell & Simon (1972) Human Problem Solving [Turing & Nobel Laureates]
primitives.brain_mechanism: Rostrolateral prefrontal cortex (rlPFC / BA10) hierarchical subgoal branching & backward working-memory maintenance (Koechlin & Summerfield, Trends Cogn. Sci. 2007)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: T_inv(S_goal) = {s in S | exists a in A: P(S_goal | s, a) = 1}, pruning forward branching factor b^d to directed predecessor constraints.
primitives.trigger_signature: Forward search space exhibits exponential branching, terminal state is uniquely constrained, or problem requires necessary preconditions and invariant backward deduction.
mandatory_slots: [Terminal_Anchor]: Formalize exact target state S_goal or terminal algebraic identity.
[Predecessor_Necessary_Conditions]: Derive strict necessary conditions backwards step-by-step from S_goal to initial premises S_0.
[Forward_Branch_Pruning]: Eliminate forward candidates violating inverted necessary conditions.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit blind forward trial-and-error enumeration and unguided sequential guessing.

primitives.name_zh_en: 结构同构迁移 (Structural Isomorphism Mapping)
primitives.academic_citation: Gentner (1983) Structure-Mapping Theory [Rumelhart Prize]; Holyoak & Thagard (1989) Analogical Mapping by Constraint Satisfaction
primitives.brain_mechanism: Frontopolar cortex (BA10) & dorsolateral PFC relational integration across distinct semantic domains (Bunge et al., Cereb. Cortex 2005)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: f: G_src(V_s, E_s) -> G_tgt(V_t, E_t) such that (u,v) in E_s <=> (f(u), f(v)) in E_t, stripping surface lexical semantics while preserving relational invariants.
primitives.trigger_signature: Unfamiliar domain wording, contrastive scientific mechanism, or complex narrative masking a canonical mathematical or logical structure.
mandatory_slots: [Surface_Semantics_Stripping]: Strip domain-specific nouns and narrative distractors into abstract relational entities V.
[Relational_Isomorphism]: Map predicates E_tgt onto a solved canonical formal structure G_src.
[Invariant_Transfer]: Transfer the theorem or invariant from G_src to instantiate the target conclusion.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit superficial lexical matching (Surface Analogy Trap) where word similarity masks structural divergence.

primitives.name_zh_en: 控制论闭环纠偏 (Cybernetic Error-Triggered Backtracking)
primitives.academic_citation: Wiener (1948) Cybernetics [National Medal of Science]; Nelson & Narens (1990) Metacognitive Monitoring and Control
primitives.brain_mechanism: Dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC) conflict detection & prefrontal executive control loop (Botvinick et al., Psychol. Rev. 2001)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: e_t = ||C(s_t) - C_ref||; if e_t > tau, trigger deterministic Backtrack(s_t -> s_{t-k}) and update constraint set Pi_{t+1}.
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-constraint deduction, state-space satisfaction, or algebraic derivation where intermediate steps must satisfy global boundary conditions.
mandatory_slots: [State_Checkpoint]: Define verifiable intermediate invariant or symbolic checkpoint s_t.
[Constraint_Residual_Audit]: Verify intermediate state against all hard boundary constraints C_ref.
[Closed_Loop_Correction]: Confirm zero residual or prune contradicted branch cleanly without repetitive self-doubt loops.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit sunk-cost continuation along a contradicted path and repetitive verbal re-reading loops.

primitives.name_zh_en: 认知闭合与前提边界监控 (Epistemic Closure & Premise Gating)
primitives.canonical_archetype: Strict Deductive Entailment vs. Extrapolation Gating
primitives.academic_citation: Stanovich (2011) Rationality and the Reflective Mind; Fleming & Dolan (2012) Neural Basis of Metacognitive Ability, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B
primitives.brain_mechanism: Anterior prefrontal cortex (aPFC) second-order metacognitive confidence & belief-bias inhibition (Fleming & Frith, Neurosci. Conscious. 2014)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Partition premise space P into {P_entailed, P_independent, P_contradicted} under strict first-order epistemic closure.
primitives.trigger_signature: Formal syllogisms, first-order logic (FOLIO), adversarial reading comprehension (LogiQA), or underspecified premises tempting real-world hallucination.
mandatory_slots: [Explicit_Premise_Inventory]: Enumerate strictly what is entailed by the stated premises P.
[Epistemic_Closure_Boundary]: Separate deductive entailment (P |= q) from plausible world-knowledge presuppositions.
[Decisive_Verdict]: Commit strictly to True, False, Uncertain, or the logically entailed option.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Belief Bias (accepting logically invalid conclusions because they sound empirically familiar).

primitives.name_zh_en: 第一性公理化拆解 (First-Principles Axiom Deconstruction)
primitives.academic_citation: Aristotle Organon; Hilbert (1899) Foundations of Geometry; Newell, Shaw & Simon (1958) Logic Theorist [Turing Laureates]
primitives.brain_mechanism: Ventrolateral & dorsolateral PFC rule-based deductive network overriding associative heuristics (Goel & Dolan, Cognition 2003)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Decompose composite proposition X into minimal orthogonal axiom basis {a_1, ..., a_k} such that X = F(a_1, ..., a_k) and I(a_i; a_j) = 0.
primitives.trigger_signature: Physical/scientific mechanism analysis, multi-step mathematical proof, or counter-intuitive problems obscured by surface rules of thumb.
mandatory_slots: [Heuristic_Assumption_Stripping]: Discard unverified surface heuristics andshortcuts.
[Irreducible_Axioms]: State the exact physical, algebraic, or number-theoretic laws governing the problem.
[Axiomatic_Reconstruction]: Execute step-by-step symbolic derivation from the axioms to the exact closed-form answer.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit reasoning by loose analogy when exact mathematical or physical conservation laws determine the answer.

primitives.name_zh_en: 最小描述长度剃刀剪枝 (Minimum Description Length Parsimony)
primitives.academic_citation: Shannon (1948); Rissanen (1978) Minimum Description Length [IEEE Hamming Medal]; Grunwald (2007) The MDL Principle
primitives.brain_mechanism: Cortical predictive coding & variational free-energy complexity minimization (Friston, Nat. Rev. Neurosci. 2010)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: H^* = argmin_{H in M} [L(H) + L(D | H)], penalizing ad-hoc auxiliary assumptions in diagnostic and abductive inference.
primitives.trigger_signature: Competing diagnostic explanations, abductive commonsense multi-hop queries, or eliminating over-parameterized distractors.
mandatory_slots: [Candidate_Hypotheses_Complexity]: Compare competing hypotheses H_i by counting unverified auxiliary assumptions L(H_i).
[Razor_Filter]: Prune ad-hoc or conjunction-inflated explanations when a parsimonious causal law explains D.
[Minimal_Sufficient_Explanation]: Select H^* minimizing total description length L(H) + L(D|H).
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Conjunction Fallacy (Tversky & Kahneman, 1983) and elaborate narrative overfitting.

primitives.name_zh_en: 波普尔证伪与反例检验 (Popperian Falsification & Counterexample Probe)
primitives.academic_citation: Popper (1959) The Logic of Scientific Discovery [FRS / Kyoto Prize]; Wason (1960) On the Failure to Eliminate Hypotheses
primitives.brain_mechanism: Right inferior frontal gyrus (rIFG) & dlPFC inhibitory suppression of confirmation bias (Houdé et al., J. Cogn. Neurosci. 2000)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: To test universal claim forall x: P(x) => Q(x), search for witness x_0 in {x | P(x) and not Q(x)} or confounder Z rendering X _||_ Y | Z.
primitives.trigger_signature: Universal logical claims, correlation-vs-causation fallacies, necessary-vs-sufficient condition traps, and multiple-choice distractor refutation.
mandatory_slots: [Fact_vs_Claim_Separation]: Separate stated empirical facts from the universal or causal claim under test.
[Counterexample_Confounder_Probe]: Construct the sharpest boundary counterexample x_0 or unobserved confounder Z.
[Surviving_Proposition]: Retain strictly the unique proposition surviving deductive falsification.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Confirmation Bias (seeking only supporting instances while ignoring disconfirming cases).

primitives.name_zh_en: 诺特对称不变量与条件化融合 (Symmetry Invariant & Regime Synthesis)
primitives.academic_citation: Noether (1918) Invariante Variationsprobleme; Weyl (1952) Symmetry; Polya (1954) Mathematics and Plausible Reasoning
primitives.brain_mechanism: Intraparietal sulcus (IPS) & frontoparietal network algebraic invariance representation (Dehaene et al., Neuron 2004)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Identify group action G leaving functional J(S) invariant (J(gS)=J(S)) or partition domain Theta = Theta_+ U Theta_- across regime boundaries.
primitives.trigger_signature: Algebraic/combinatorial symmetry, parity/modular invariants, conservation laws, or coupled equations solvable via invariant substitution.
mandatory_slots: [Symmetry_Dual_Identification]: Identify structural symmetry, parity, or conserved quantity across transformations.
[Invariant_Extraction]: Express the problem in terms of invariant polynomials, modular residues, or regime boundaries.
[Synthesized_Resolution]: Compute the exact solution via the conserved invariant without brute-force expansion.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit asymmetric brute-force expansion when structural symmetry or conservation collapses algebraic degree.

primitives.name_zh_en: 结构因果图干预与存量流量 (Structural Causal DAG & do-Calculus)
primitives.academic_citation: Pearl (2009) Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference [ACM Turing Award]; Spirtes, Glymour & Scheines (2000); Forrester (1961)
primitives.brain_mechanism: Orbitofrontal-hippocampal cognitive map encoding directed causal state transitions (Wikenheiser & Schoenbaum, Nat. Rev. Neurosci. 2016)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: SCM M = <U, V, F, P(U)> with interventional distribution P(Y | do(X=x)) = sum_z P(Y | X=x, Z=z) P(Z=z) under backdoor admissibility.
primitives.trigger_signature: Observational vs. interventional queries (CLadder Rungs 1-3), Simpson's paradox, collider bias, mediation, or counterfactuals.
mandatory_slots: [Causal_Topology_DAG]: Map directed causal edges (X -> Y), common-cause confounders (X <- Z -> Y), and mediators/colliders.
[Do_Calculus_Adjustment]: Distinguish observational P(Y|X) from interventional P(Y|do(X)) via graph surgery or backdoor adjustment.
[Net_Causal_Effect]: Compute exact marginal, interventional, or counterfactual probability to decide Yes/No.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit conflating observational correlation P(Y|X) with causal intervention P(Y|do(X)).

primitives.name_zh_en: 最大流最小割瓶颈锁定 (Min-Cut Bottleneck & Critical-Path Localization)
primitives.academic_citation: Ford & Fulkerson (1956) Maximal Flow Through a Network; Karp (1972) Reducibility Among Combinatorial Problems [ACM Turing Award]
primitives.brain_mechanism: Dorsal frontoparietal attention network (DAN) capacity-limited bottleneck gating (Marois & Ivanoff, Trends Cogn. Sci. 2005)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Throughput Phi(G) = min_{(S,T) cut} Cap(S,T); local sensitivity dPhi / dCap(e_j) = 0 for all slack edges outside the minimum cut.
primitives.trigger_signature: Limiting-reagent chemistry/physics, capacity-constrained pipelines, tightest inequality bounds, or decisive logical bottleneck conditions.
mandatory_slots: [Constraint_Chain_Quantification]: Quantify coupled capacities, rates, or inequality bounds across stages.
[Binding_Bottleneck_Lock]: Isolate the unique minimum-cut or limiting constraint v^* governing global output.
[Non_Bottleneck_Pruning]: Prune slack variables and compute the outcome directly from v^*.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit averaging or optimizing non-binding slack variables that have zero marginal impact on the limiting bound.

primitives.name_zh_en: 多阶动态规划效应树 (Bellman Multi-Order Consequence Tree)
primitives.academic_citation: Bellman (1957) Dynamic Programming [IEEE Medal of Honor]; Howard (1960) Dynamic Programming and Markov Processes; Arthur (1989)
primitives.brain_mechanism: Hippocampal-medial PFC prospective episodic replay & multi-step lookahead simulation (Mattar & Daw, Nat. Neurosci. 2018)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: V(s_t) = max_a [r(s_t, a) + E_{s_{t+1} ~ T(s_t, a)} V(s_{t+1})], tracking state transitions across deterministic or stochastic steps.
primitives.trigger_signature: Sequential state-tracking tasks (BBH tracking shuffled objects, boolean/dyck stacks), multi-hop causal chains, or delayed feedback.
mandatory_slots: [Initial_State_Vector]: Write down the explicit state mapping s_0 before step t=1.
[Stepwise_State_Transition]: Update exact state s_{t} -> s_{t+1} across every operation without skipping intermediate swaps.
[Terminal_State_Readout]: Read off the requested entity or value directly from terminal state s_T.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit myopic first-step shortcuts and unindexed mental state tracking on sequential permutation problems.

primitives.name_zh_en: 关系图论拓扑与宏观涌现 (Relational Graph Topology & Macro-Emergence)
primitives.academic_citation: Euler (1736); Tarjan (1972) Depth-First Search and Linear Graph Algorithms [ACM Turing Award]; Anderson (1972) More Is Different [Nobel Prize]
primitives.brain_mechanism: Entorhinal-hippocampal grid/graph relational space coding of non-spatial cognitive hierarchies (Behrens et al., Cell 2018)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Construct directed graph G=(V,E) from local pairwise relations (u < v) and extract global topological order or connected invariants.
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-entity ordering/ranking puzzles (BBH logical deduction), spatial/temporal scheduling, ecological food webs, or graph connectivity.
mandatory_slots: [Node_Edge_Adjacency_Graph]: Encode all pairwise comparative or spatial constraints into directed edges E.
[Topological_Ordering]: Resolve transitive closures and anchor unique positions (1st..Nth) without contradiction.
[Global_Rank_Readout]: Extract the exact queried entity or truth assignment from the assembled graph.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit evaluating pairwise clues in isolation without transitive global graph assembly.

primitives.name_zh_en: 贝叶斯基率—似然动态校准 (Bayesian Prior-Likelihood Calibration)
primitives.academic_citation: Bayes (1763); Laplace (1812); Tversky & Kahneman (1974) Judgment under Uncertainty, Science [Nobel Prize]; Tenenbaum et al. (2011) Science
primitives.brain_mechanism: Lateral intraparietal & dorsolateral PFC logarithmic likelihood-ratio accumulation (Yang & Shadlen, Nature 2007; Pouget et al., Nat. Neurosci. 2013)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: P(H | E) = P(E | H)P(H) / [P(E | H)P(H) + P(E | ~H)P(~H)]; Law of Total Probability P(E) = sum_i P(E | H_i)P(H_i).
primitives.trigger_signature: Conditional probability, marginalization, diagnostic sensitivity/specificity, or base-rate puzzles.
mandatory_slots: [Base_Rate_Prior]: Anchor explicit prior probabilities P(H) and complement P(~H) = 1 - P(H).
[Likelihood_Decomposition]: State exact conditional or joint terms P(E|H) and P(E|~H).
[Posterior_or_Marginal_Update]: Compute exact Bayes posterior P(H|E) or total probability P(E) to verify the query.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Base-Rate Neglect (confusing inverse conditional P(H|E) with P(E|H)).

primitives.name_zh_en: 博弈均衡与非对称资源配比 (Minimax Equilibrium & Asymmetric Allocation)
primitives.canonical_archetype: Minimax / Nash Equilibrium & Colonel Blotto Asymmetric Matching ('Tian Ji' Strategic Allocation)
mapped_folk_models: Colonel Blotto / Tian Ji Asymmetric Matching
primitives.academic_citation: Borel (1921) Colonel Blotto Theory; von Neumann & Morgenstern (1944) Minimax; Nash (1950) Equilibrium Points, PNAS [Nobel Prize]; Kuhn (1955)
primitives.brain_mechanism: Medial PFC & temporoparietal junction (TPJ) recursive Theory-of-Mind strategic opponent modeling (Coricelli & Nagel, PNAS 2009)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: s^* = argmax_{s_i} min_{s_{-i}} u_i(s_i, s_{-i}); under heterogeneous resource vectors, optimize pairwise assignment pi^* maximizing sum_k I(r_{pi(k)} > c_k).
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-agent strategic games, asymmetric resource/matchup optimization, dominant-strategy elimination, or incentive compatibility.
mandatory_slots: [Agents_Payoff_Matrix]: Formalize players, strategy sets, or ranked resource vectors and payoff rules.
[Best_Response_Asymmetric_Match]: Eliminate dominated actions or compute optimal asymmetric matchup response.
[Equilibrium_Verdict]: Derive the unique Nash, Minimax, or optimal assignment outcome.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit naive symmetric head-to-head matching and assuming rational opponents ignore incentive shifts.

primitives.name_zh_en: 詹森凸性与非遍历尾部风险 (Jensen Convexity & Non-Ergodic Tail Risk)
primitives.academic_citation: Jensen (1906) Sur les fonctions convexes; Arrow (1965) Aspects of the Theory of Risk-Bearing [Nobel Prize]; Rockafellar & Uryasev (2000) CVaR
primitives.brain_mechanism: Anterior insula & ventral striatum asymmetric variance and tail-risk encoding (Preuschoff, Bossaerts & Quartz, Neuron 2006)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: For convex f, E[f(X)] >= f(E[X]); under multiplicative dynamics X_{t+1} = X_t(1 + r_t), time-average growth g = E[log(1+r)] != log(1 + E[r]).
primitives.trigger_signature: Inequality bounds, expectation vs. nonlinear function E[f(X)], multiplicative compounding, or worst-case boundary analysis.
mandatory_slots: [Nonlinear_Payoff_Curvature]: Identify convexity/concavity of f(x) orabsorbing boundary constraints.
[Jensen_or_WorstCase_Bound]: Apply Jensen's inequality, AM-GM/Cauchy-Schwarz, or tail-bound evaluation.
[Exact_Extremal_Result]: Compute the tight bound or extremal value.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Flaw of Averages (substituting E[f(X)] with f(E[X]) for nonlinear functions).

primitives.name_zh_en: 边际机会成本与沉没成本剥离 (Marginal Opportunity & Sunk-Cost Pruning)
primitives.canonical_archetype: Kantorovich Shadow-Price Allocation & Irrelevant Sunk-Cost Pruning
primitives.academic_citation: Kantorovich (1939) Mathematical Methods of Organizing Production [Nobel Prize]; Samuelson (1947) [Nobel Prize]; Thaler (1980) [Nobel Prize]
primitives.brain_mechanism: Ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) & orbitofrontal cortex marginal subjective value comparison (Kable & Glimcher, Nat. Neurosci. 2007)
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Optimize incremental objective Delta U(a) = U(s_0 + a) - U(s_0) subject to binding resource budget B, invariant to historical sunk expenditure C_sunk.
primitives.trigger_signature: Rate/work word problems, resource optimization, net incremental rate calculation, or sunk-cost distractor elimination.
mandatory_slots: [Sunk_Distractor_Pruning]: Strip historical sunk quantities and irrelevant narrative numbers.
[Marginal_Unit_Rate]: Express exact per-unit marginal rates, prices, or incremental deltas.
[Net_Optimal_Calculation]: Integrate marginal contributions over active constraints to obtain the exact numeric answer.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Sunk-Cost Fallacy (including irrecoverable past quantities in forward marginal equations).
